name: Suicide Mau Maus
description: The Suicide Mau Maus, who later called themselves the 'Suicides,' were a Puerto Rican youth gang based in the Farragut Projects in Brooklyn during the 1950s and early 1960s. The gang had about a dozen members and was much smaller than the Mau Maus, with whom they had a violent rivalry.
